name: Low-Power VLSI Design for AI & Edge Systems
description:
Power consumption in VLSI: dynamic, static, and leakage mechanisms
Power estimation and measurement across RTL, gate, and physical design levels
Low-power CMOS design techniques and energy-efficient logic styles
Clocking strategies: clock gating, multi-clock domains, and power-aware timing
Power gating, multi-Vt cells, isolation, and level shifter insertion
Low-power RTL coding practices and architectural power optimization
Voltage scaling, DVFS, and adaptive power management techniques
Memory and interconnect power optimization for AI and edge workloads
Hardware–software co-design for energy-efficient AI and edge systems
Case studies and labs on low-power AI accelerators and edge VLSI designs
